mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy heads towards a potential recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline y-o-y by > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, indicating a tightening monetary policy, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 jobs per month, it signals a very tight labor market that could lead to wage inflation, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k/month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and rising, indicating strong manufacturing growth, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts positively to the improving economic outlook.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and rising but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing by more than 3% year-over-year and consumer sentiment (proxied by retail sales RSAFS) is also strong, with growth above 5% year-over-year, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in the strong consumer demand.
failure_condition: GDPC1 y-o-y growth > 3% and RSAFS y-o-y growth > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.
